mapping.purpose: Business statement to explicit alternative causal questions and missing information
mapping.limits: No automatic truth or unique target

mapping.purpose: Validate graph syntax, timing and evidence for proposed edges
mapping.limits: Syntactic checks do not establish causal graph correctness

mapping.purpose: Run a selected declared discovery method and preserve equivalence class
mapping.limits: No arbitrary latent temporal inference; candidate engine qualification required

mapping.purpose: Identify under a supplied graph or return a bounded nonidentification/unsupported disposition
mapping.limits: causal_workflow.adjustment_expression handles a supplied DAG/back-door case; unsupported adjustment is not general nonidentification
No automatic bank experimentation or assignment truth

mapping.purpose: Run a declared estimator in a declared sampling/model regime
mapping.limits: R01/R03 are qualified only in their registered synthetic scopes; R02/R04/R05 remain negative
Sensitivity sets, sampling confidence and posterior credibility remain distinct

mapping.purpose: Check source ownership, inclusion, measurement and information-clock declarations
mapping.limits: Checks cannot manufacture gold truth or validate declarations scientifically

mapping.purpose: Render an evidence-grounded report with conditional/negative conclusions
mapping.limits: A report does not promote capability or claim independent acceptance
Availability is exact runtime-specific, not inferred from package names

mapping.purpose: Inspect authorized durable job state and result handles
mapping.limits: No scientific conclusion follows from completed job status

mapping.purpose: Request cooperative cancellation of an authorized job
mapping.limits: May race with completion; published complete result remains immutable

request_input: One UTF-8 JSON request from an explicit file or stdin; no shell code evaluation.
stdout: Exactly one canonical JSON response for a completed synchronous invocation; progress/logs on stderr. No trailing human-only line after JSON.

exit_codes.0: Completed scientific disposition including computed/not_identified/unsupported/unavailable/refused; inspect disposition.
exit_codes.2: Malformed request, unsupported schema or invalid scientific declarations.
exit_codes.3: Missing artifact/engine/model/access required to invoke the requested operation.
exit_codes.4: Internal execution failure; retain failure identity.
exit_codes.130: Client interruption before normal result; job status query is needed for durable work.

long_jobs: Submit returns a job handle; job.status polls and job.cancel requests cancellation. Durable jobs do not require keeping the terminal connected.
default_permissions: Local configured artifact roots, no sibling mutation or upload; raw shell and arbitrary imports are never user-selectable operations.
compatibility: Help/version/capabilities declare exact schema/operation/engine support and limits; unsupported operations are not advertised as qualified.
science_v_transport: Exit zero does not mean an effect is identified, precise, qualified or accepted.
